from pathlib import Path
import json
# transform based on exact translated pattern of all 8s
src='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    if not marks:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in marks)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in marks)
    pattern = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in marks]
    ph = max(r for r, c in pattern) + 1
    pw = max(c for r, c in pattern) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    recolor = set()
    for r in range(h-ph+1):
        for c in range(w-pw+1):
            cells = [(r+dr, c+dc) for dr, dc in pattern]
            if all(grid[x][y] == 0 for x, y in cells):
                recolor.update(cells)
    for r, c in recolor:
        out[r][c] = 8
    return out
'''
# demo set input/output variables
exec(src)
print(transform(inp)==out, sum(a==8 and b==0 for rowa,rowb in zip(transform(inp),inp) for a,b in zip(rowa,rowb)))
